## Competitor Analysis 2026

Halvorsen Industrial Systems - Management - owner: Gabriel Eisner

## 1. Grundfors Pumps

Positioning: market leader, strong brand, 12% price premium.

Estimated European revenue EUR 1014m. Our win rate against them in 2025: 22%.

## 2. Wilmar Fluid

Positioning: aggressive pricing in Iberia, weaker service network.

Estimated European revenue EUR 701m. Our win rate against them in 2025: 51%.

## 3. KSV Pumpen

Positioning: strong in DACH chemicals, long lead times.

Estimated European revenue EUR 584m. Our win rate against them in 2025: 38%.

## 4. Sulzbach Flow

Positioning: premium high-pressure range, competing with HX-700.

Estimated European revenue EUR 2376m. Our win rate against them in 2025: 41%.
